summary: Backcountry skier suffered a fatal medical emergency near Larkspur Road, approximately three miles northeast of Lenado; the medical emergency was reported to the Pitkin County Regional Emergency Dispatch Center at 6:40 p.m. and escalated to the Sheriff's Office, and Mountain Rescue Aspen volunteers were mobilized. By the time the first MRA field team arrived via snowmobiles at 8:45 p.m., the skier had lost consciousness, was in agonal breathing, and despite CPR efforts was declared deceased. MRA transported the body and the remaining party members back to the trailhead and handed custody to the Pitkin County Coroner's Office.
location: Larkspur Road, ~3 miles northeast of Lenado (near Margy's Hut)
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen, Pitkin County Sheriff's Office, Pitkin County Regional Emergency Dispatch Center, Pitkin County Coroner
notes: Incident date 2026-01-23 per Mountain Rescue Aspen Facebook page post published 2026-01-24; medical cause not specified in the page post. Deduped against existing index: no prior Larkspur Road/Lenado/Margy's Hut rows. Not present in CSV prior to this pass.
